name: procurement-strict
description: The PRD §11 instruction verbatim. 'Never spend more than $150' is a hard ceiling, so $203 at Staples is DENIED, not stepped up — which contradicts the demo script in the PRD. See DECISIONS.md, open question OQ-1.
intent_text: You may spend $500 per month on office supplies. Amazon and Staples are approved. Never spend more than $150 in a single transaction. Ask me before buying from another merchant.

policy.summary: Spend up to $500 per calendar month on office supplies at Amazon and Staples, never more than $150 at once, with your approval required at any other merchant.
compiler_notes: 'Never spend more than $150' read as a hard ceiling, so amounts above it are denied outright rather than escalated for approval.

assumptions: Read 'never more than $150' as a hard limit: transactions above it are denied, not sent to you for approval. Say 'ask me before spending more than $150' if you would rather approve them.
Mapped 'Amazon' to amazon.com and 'Staples' to staples.com.
Blocked gambling, cash advance, crypto, adult, and firearms outright.
Set this authority to expire in 30 days.
